semantic_insights: The record consistently distinguishes 300 participants from 23,533 recordings and separates the feature-only PhysioNet release from controlled raw-audio access.
Source caveats explicitly separate adult-project documentation from pediatric-release evidence and retain the attribution and tense of umbrella-protocol statements.
The funding discrepancy and the Jennifer Sui/Siu attribution uncertainty are acknowledged without inventing an equivalence or adding unsupported funding.
Human-subject status is consistent with the documented REB approval, informed consent, and pediatric protections.
Per-feature counts of 23,532 and 23,533 are accompanied by an explanation that some recordings could not generate particular features; they are not treated as contradictory participant counts.
Standard feature formats, detailed tensor descriptions, a versioned processing library, and explicit access requirements provide useful technical and reuse information.
No observed cross-field contradiction independently reduced a score; deductions reflect incomplete documentation or explicit rubric thresholds.
